title: Bush and LBJ briefed on JFK assassination at Clint Murchison's ranch
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Bush and LBJ briefed on JFK assassination at Clint Murchison's ranch, about 1963 at Clint Murchison ranch, Dallas, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he was he was in a meeting at the ranch of Clint merchon is where not the one in Waka but the one in Dallas

plain: Dan Sheehan, a guest on a podcast episode about American conspiracies, talks about the 1963 killing of President John F. Kennedy in Dallas. He says that George H.W. Bush, later a president himself, was at a meeting at the ranch of a man named Clint Murchison in Dallas, not his other ranch in Waco, and he links Lyndon Johnson, then vice president, and J. Edgar Hoover, the head of the FBI, to being briefed there. If true, it would mean powerful men knew about the killing around the time it happened.
